inclusions.source: An English-speaking Egyptologist guide accompanies you throughout, with a private air-conditioned vehicle for both directions.

inclusions.text: Operator handles all travel permits and any required escort logistics
inclusions.source: The drive across the Eastern Desert is itself part of the day; the landscape between Marsa Alam and Aswan is some of Egypt's most empty and most geologically dramatic country, and the operator handles all travel permits and any required escort logistics in advance.

inclusions.text: Pickup between roughly 5 and 6 AM, return to your hotel
inclusions.source: Pickup is between roughly 5 and 6 AM, the drive across the Eastern Desert takes about three and a half hours, you have roughly four hours on the ground in Aswan visiting three sites, and the return drive brings you back to your hotel in the early evening.
